subject: Post-call: Cross-border routing & deployment options — next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Håkansson <marco@fjordbank.se>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cross-border routing & deployment options — next steps

Hi Marco / Fjord team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion. Below is a concise recap and the concrete next steps we agreed on.

Key takeaways
- Residency requirement: primary data storage and processing must remain within the EEA (Sweden preferred) for customer-identifiable data.
- APAC reach: Fjord operates a small ops footprint in APAC; you need predictable low-latency inference from Singapore/Tokyo for a pilot.
- Failure/fallback policy: you prefer cross-region fallback rather than returning errors (acceptable to fall back to a lower-cost EU-hosted variant but only if data residency is preserved or anonymized).

Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (high-level)
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding. We can pin compute & storage to an EU region for routing and data residency; cross-region fallback is configurable but can be restricted to anonymized or non-PII workloads.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools in an EU region with stronger isolation and SLAs — good fit if you expect sustained throughput and need predictability.
- Private VPC / on-prem: customer-managed network + KMS; required if your internal auditors insist on end-to-end control for keys and network egress.

Open questions we noted (please confirm):
1) Expected QPS and token volume for the pilot (estimate pi/day or tokens/min).
2) Classification: will the inference payload include customer-identifiable data (PII) or will you tokenize/anonymize before sending?
3) Procurement timeline: when does Fjord need a pricing band for Dedicated vs Private?

Next steps (owner + ETA)
- Fjord: confirm expected volume and PII classification by 2026-09-03 — Marco (owner).
- Redwood: share a one-pager comparing region-pinning behaviors, DLP options, and a ballpark Dedicated pricing table — Neha (by 2026-08-30). Attachment: deployment-options-onepager.pdf
- Redwood Security: send SOC 2 summary and any data-flow diagrams we have — Neha (attached: SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra team (we suggested Wed 2026-09-08, 2pm CET).

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF), deployment-options-onepager.pdf (PDF)

If any of the bullets above are off, reply inline and we'll adjust. Otherwise I'll follow up with the one-pager and pricing band later this week.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 12:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cross-border routing & deployment options — next steps

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Residency: EEA (Sweden) is a must for data at rest and for PII processing. Can Redwood guarantee that inference logs and KV cache are kept in-region and not replicated globally?
- APAC latency: pilot will need <120ms median tail from Singapore to meet customer SLAs. If Hosted can offer EU compute + APAC edge routing with local cache, that might be sufficient for the pilot. Is that something you support?
- Fallbacks: we prefer automatic fallback to another EU region variant rather than falling back to US or other non-EEA regions; if fallback goes outside EU it must be on anonymized data only.
- Pricing: procurement wants a broad ballpark for Dedicated monthly commit versus a Hosted usage estimate for 10k requests/day (avg 250 tokens per request). Can you provide both?

Attached: FjordBank-Compliance-Questionnaire.pdf (their form).

We'll aim to give the volume/PII answers by next Friday. Also looping in Legal and IT Ops for technical Qs.

Thanks,
Marco Håkansson
Head of Product, Fjord Bank
marco@fjordbank.se

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Håkansson <marco@fjordbank.se>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, IT Ops <itops@fjordbank.se>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 15:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cross-border routing & deployment options — next steps

Hi Marco — appreciate the specifics. Quick answers below, and we can cover the rest in a tech deep-dive.

1) In-region data: For Hosted we can pin data-at-rest and primary inference to an EU region (we typically recommend eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 depending on latency). Logs and KV cache can be configured to remain in-region; we will flag any cross-region replication in the deployment config.

2) APAC edge/cache: We support regional edge-cache nodes for KV/prefix caching which significantly reduces tail latency for repeat prompts. For cold-starts you will see EU -> APAC network RTT; depending on volume, a Dedicated pool in APAC or a Private VPC with a local gateway may be necessary to hit <120ms median tail.

3) Fallback policy: we can configure fallback policies by workload classification. For PII-tagged routes we can disable cross-region fallback entirely, or allow fallback only to anonymized variants.

4) Pricing ballpark: I'll send a short pricing matrix (Hosted estimate for 10k req/day @ avg 250 tokens + Dedicated 4-GPU monthly commit options) in the one-pager.

Proposed next step: tech deep-dive with infra/eng Wed 2026-09-08 14:00 CET (I will send a calendar invite after you confirm).

Attachments: deployment-options-onepager.pdf

Regards,
Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: Fjord Bank follow-up — prep for tech deep-dive

Team — internal action items before the Wed deep-dive with Fjord Bank (DEAL-8421):

1) Engineering prep (Rachel):
- Please prepare a short doc showing region-pinning mechanics (how logs/KV are scoped to a region), and the rollout options for APAC edge caches vs Dedicated APAC pools. Include any measurable latency numbers from eu->sgp hops we have from benchmark tests.
- Be ready to discuss encryption + KMS options (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed).

2) Product & Pricing (Stephanie):
- Draft a Hosted usage estimate for 10k req/day, 250 tokens/req, including token cost and expected egress.
- Draft Dedicated pricing tiers for 4-GPU and 8-GPU monthly commits and note SLA differences.

3) Security artifacts (Neha):
- I'll draft answers to the Fjord compliance questionnaire (attaching a working copy: fjordbank-compliance-answers.pdf) and send SOC2 summary.

We should assume Fjord will push for either Dedicated EU + APAC edge or a Private VPC in EU with an APAC Dedicated pool for the pilot.

Please add any additional items to the shared doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/deploy-onepager-fjordbank and I'll book the Wed call once Marco confirms.

Neha
